**Senior Software Engineer**

**Job Family:** Software Engineer

**City/State:** Colorado Springs, CO USA

**Type and Schedule:** Full\-Time, Salary/Exempt, on\-site with limited remote work flexibility.

**Annualized Salary Range:** $135,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 commensurate with experience.

**About Us:**


Caliola is an award\-winning woman\-owned small business that is improving and protecting our Nation's way of life through secure collaboration and resilient communications. Our engineers, subject matter experts, and veterans are developing and delivering trusted solutions for mission\-critical communications. We seek teammates who share our core values:

**I****3** **for C****3** **\- Insight, Innovation, and Integrity for Command, Control, and Communications**


These values guide how we work every day. At Caliola, you will find technically challenging, mission\-focused work within a flexible and collaborative culture that is uncommon in the defense industry. We offer flexible PTO, subsidized health insurance, 401(k) matching, professional development, and a competitive compensation structure designed to support long\-term growth.

**Position Description:**

Caliola Engineering is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to build software that solves complex, meaningful problems in support of mission\-critical applications. You will work alongside a collaborative engineering team to turn advanced technical capabilities into intuitive, reliable products supporting missions such as communications planning, A\-PNT, and secure mesh networking. This is a hands\-on role for an experienced engineer who wants to own challenging problems, influence technical direction, and help shape how our software evolves. You will contribute directly to development while providing technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, strengthening both the product and the team around you. Our stack includes TypeScript, Vue.js, and Nuxt on the frontend, Nitro and Node.js for backend services, and Tauri for desktop applications. If you enjoy building thoughtful software, solving problems where the answer is not always obvious, and seeing your work contribute to real\-world mission impact, this role gives you the opportunity to do exactly that.

**Essential Responsibilities:**


UI Development

* Build responsive, reliable user interfaces that meet approved designs and technical requirements.
* Regularly contribute production\-quality code and deliver functionality within agreed timelines.
* Develop and maintain reusable UI components aligned with Caliola's design system.


Technical Leadership

* Translate project requirements into technical requirements, development tasks, and project milestones.
* Help organize and prioritize development work using agile tools and practices, including leading or supporting agile meetings.
* Provide technical guidance to other developers through code reviews, collaboration, and reinforcement of development standards while working effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.


User Experience

* Implement intuitive workflows and interactions that support user and mission needs.
* Partner with UI/UX and stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical constraints, and develop effective solutions.
* Identify and help resolve usability issues throughout development.


Frontend Quality

* Write clean, maintainable, tested code that meets development standards.
* Define and implement appropriate unit and system testing.
* Identify and resolve defects, performance issues, and browser or device inconsistencies.


System Integration

* Integrate frontend applications with APIs, services, databases, and backend systems.
* Coordinate interface requirements and troubleshoot integration issues across the application stack.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support reliable software delivery.


DocumentImprove

* Maintain technical documentation, reusable components, and project deliverables.
* Support customer\-facing documentation and progress reporting as needed.
* Contribute to improvements in frontend tools, standards, processes, and development practices.

**What We Require:**

* Current or recent (within the last 5 years) U.S. Department of War security clearance at the Secret level or higher.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of directly relevant professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining production frontend applications, preferably with a Department of War contractor.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript, with production experience using a modern frontend framework such as Vue, React, Solid, or Angular.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming concepts and modern frontend application architecture.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with server\-side technologies such as Node.js, Rust, Go, or Python.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices.
* Strong technical communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and UI/UX teams.

**What We Value:**

* Experience working with SQL or NoSQL databases and developing full\-stack applications.
* Strong understanding of software architecture principles, including modularization, separation of concerns, maintainability, and application development at enterprise scale.
* Experience translating high\-level customer needs into functional requirements and technical solutions.
* Experience modernizing, refactoring, or sustaining existing applications.
* Curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, tools, and design approaches.

**Embedded Firmware Engineer**

ARCO is seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our engineering team and help develop intelligent power\-management products for the marine, RV, and mobile\-power industries.

This is a hands\-on embedded development role focused primarily on C/C\+\+ firmware development. You will help maintain and improve the firmware behind our Zeus Alternator Control System, develop new features for existing products, and contribute to R\&D and firmware architecture for future products.

We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to the hardware and enjoys solving real\-world embedded systems problems involving firmware, electronics, communications, sensors, and control systems.

**What You’ll Do**

· Develop, maintain, and improve embedded firmware in C and C\+\+.

· Design and implement new features for existing and future products.

· Troubleshoot firmware and hardware using debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, CAN tools, and other test equipment.

· Develop firmware involving CAN Bus, BLE, SPI, I²C, UART, ADCs, PWM, sensors, and nonvolatile memory.

· Develop and improve control algorithms for power\-management and electrical systems.

· Participate in new\-product R\&D, prototyping, hardware bring\-up, and design validation.

· Experience with embedded peripherals and interfaces such as CAN, SPI, I²C, UART, PWM, ADCs, timers, interrupts, and GPIO.

· Ability to read electrical schematics and understand hardware/firmware interactions.

· Experience debugging embedded systems with laboratory and development tools.

· Working knowledge of Git or similar version\-control systems.

· Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Aquilo**

Aquilo Sports LLC develops therapeutic medical devices for sports recovery and home healthcare. Our current development program is supported by a National Institutes of Health (NIH) SBIR Phase II award. We work closely with engineers, clinicians, researchers, and manufacturing partners to bring products from concept through clinical evaluation and commercialization. As a small, hands\-on company, we offer the chance to contribute directly to both our products and our growth.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer to develop the firmware for our Lower\-Extremity Heat Therapy (LEHT), a new medical device now in commercial development. You will be our in\-house firmware owner, carrying the code from early requirements through implementation, hardware integration, testing, and release.

You will work alongside a retained external engineering firm responsible for the system's industrial design, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering. You will have a high degree of day\-to\-day autonomy in our Louisville office, with direct access to senior external engineers for architecture decisions, difficult firmware problems, and hardware integration. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands\-on development, takes initiative, and knows when to ask for input.

**What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain embedded firmware for temperature regulation, pneumatic compression, sensors, user interfaces, and device communications.
* Contribute to software requirements, architecture, and documented firmware designs, with review from senior external engineers.
* Collaborate with external engineers on hardware interfaces, board bring\-up, debugging, and system integration.
* Implement treatment sequences, operating states, alarms, fault detection, and safe shutdown behavior.
* Develop and execute unit and integration tests, including abnormal operating conditions and failure recovery.
* Maintain source control, issue tracking, reproducible builds, and controlled firmware releases.
* Prepare software documentation and maintain traceability between requirements, implementation, and testing.
* Support prototype builds, verification activities, and investigation of issues found during device evaluation.
* Communicate progress, technical risks, and decisions clearly to the founders and engineering partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Approximately 2–5 years of embedded firmware development experience.
* Strong programming skills in C and/or C\+\+ for microcontrollers.
* Experience developing and debugging firmware on physical hardware, including interrupts, state machines, and common peripherals (I²C, SPI, UART, ADCs, PWM).
* Experience integrating sensors or actuators.
* Ability to read schematics and use hardware debuggers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Disciplined habits with version control, structured testing, and technical documentation.
* Ability to organize your own work, troubleshoot systematically, and collaborate with external engineers.
* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Firmware experience on medical devices or other products with safety\-critical functions.
* Familiarity with medical\-device software practices, including IEC 62304, requirements traceability, and software risk management.
* Substantial involvement in an embedded product from early development through testing and release.
* Experience with temperature or pressure control, pumps, valves, and related sensors.
* Experience with RTOS development, Bluetooth Low Energy, displays, or device data logging.
* Experience building scripts or tools for automated testing and data analysis.
* Effective use of AI\-assisted development tools, with the ability to independently review, test, and explain generated code.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual salary: $72,000–$84,000
* Health and dental insurance: Coverage available.
* Paid vacation: Three weeks annually.
* Hybrid flexibility: Remote work when tasks allow, with regular onsite work in Louisville for prototype development, hardware integration, and testing.
* Professional development: Direct access to senior external engineers for technical guidance and collaboration.
* Travel: Occasional travel to work with engineering and development partners.

**Why Join Aquilo?**

* Build something with a clear purpose. Your work goes into a medical device intended to support home treatment and improve patients' quality of life.
* Gain full\-lifecycle medical device experience early in your career. Work across firmware, electronics integration, verification, and clinical\-development support, with senior engineers to learn from.
* Work directly with the founders. Have a real voice in product decisions, development priorities, and how we build our engineering capability.
* Grow with the company. Take on greater technical responsibility as our products and internal team develop.

**Work Authorization**

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Aquilo is unable to sponsor employment visas now or in the future for this position.

**How to Apply**

Submit your résumé and a brief description of an embedded project you helped develop. Explain your personal responsibilities, the hardware involved, a technical challenge you resolved, and how you tested your work.

The project description may be included at the end of your résumé or in a cover letter. A brief paragraph is sufficient. Public project links are welcome; please do not submit confidential material from previous employers.

Aquilo Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $84,000\.00 per year

### **About the Position**


#### **Introduction**


**Werfen**

  

Werfen is a growing, family\-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

  

Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care.


#### **Overview**


**Position Summary:**

  

The Senior Systems Engineer supports system integration, verification, validation, defect analysis, and remediation activities throughout product development. This role is responsible for translating user needs and system requirements into system\-level verification and validation test cases, executing and documenting testing activities, supporting product risk management, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and standards. The engineer collaborates with cross\-functional teams to analyze test results, identify issues and risks, support issue resolution, and verify the implementation and effectiveness of risk controls.

  

The annual base salary range for this role is currently $110,000 to $140,000\. Individual employee compensation will ultimately depend on factors including education, relevant experience, skillset, knowledge, and particular business needs.

  

This role is eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan retirement benefits with an employer match, as well as paid vacation and sick leave.


#### **Responsibilities**


**Key Accountabilities**


**Essential Functions:**


* Owns system\-level defect analysis and remediation during System Integration, Verification, and Validation phases.
* Supports Product Risk Management activities, regulatory and standards compliance, and country approval efforts.
* Conducts risk analyses, including Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), and supports the development of risk control measures.
* Translates user needs and system requirements into system\-level verification and validation test cases with appropriate traceability.
* Executes and documents system integration, verification, and validation testing involving hardware, software, subsystems, and external interfaces.
* Analyzes test results, identifies issues and risks, and collaborates with cross\-functional teams to support timely resolution.
* Participates in system test, technical, and design reviews with a focus on verification coverage, defects, and readiness milestones.
* Supports Product Safety Risk Management activities by verifying implementation and effectiveness of assigned risk controls in a regulation\-compliant manner.
* Applies standard test practices, tools, and templates and contributes to continuous improvement of system test processes.
* Conducts cascade analysis and error budget allocation
* Effectively communicates complex technical information to a cross\-functional team in the form of documentation, presentations or technical summaries.
* Independently generates predictable schedules for activities related to assigned projects.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


The ideal candidate for this position will exhibit the following skills and capabilities:

  

* Knowledge of medical device standards and regulations, including ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, and FDA GMP/QSR, and their impact on verification and validation activities.
* Experience executing system\-level or integration test activities for complex products.
* Ability to analyze test results and identify issues and risks.
* Ability to support risk management activities, including DFMEA and risk control verification.
* Effective collaboration and communication skills within cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with requirements management, digital traceability tools, and test automation preferred.
* Experience working with electromechanical and/or mechatronic systems.
* Knowledge of system integration principles and system\-level testing methodologies.
* Understanding of embedded software design, implementation, integration, and test activities.
* Experience with control systems; stepper motor control experience preferred.
* Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot system performance issues using equipment, schematics, and algorithm analysis.
* Programming experience, preferably Python.
* Experience using test and measurement equipment, including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters (DMMs), and logic analyzers.

**Education**:

* In vitro medical device experience highly desired.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary


We are looking for a collaborative and adaptable Software Engineer to join the Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) team supporting Insulet's embedded software for medical products. This role contributes across the full software lifecycle—including design, implementation, testing, documentation, maintenance, and continuous improvement—in a regulated, multidisciplinary environment.
  

Success in this role means taking ownership of the work needed by the team, whether that involves new feature development, defect resolution, design documentation, test support, or cross\-functional integration. We value engineers who communicate openly, bring positive energy to the team, and approach every assignment as an opportunity to strengthen the product and help teammates succeed.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;
Position Overview:
  

We are looking for a self\-motivated Software Engineer to join the Research and Development team responsible for significant contributions to Software project initiatives associated with product development and improvements. This person is expected to be responsible for well\-designed and well\-tested code, with the ability to apply creative solutions to problems, and thrive in a multidiscipline team environment.
  

  

Responsibilities:


* Designs, develops, tests and documents embedded system software for new and existing Insulet products.
* Ensures that their design is in compliance with Company policies, and that software activities are appropriate for the design and maintenance of medical products.
* Writes and maintains design documentation and testing requirements.
* Works with Quality, Regulatory, Marketing and Manufacturing to ensure that designs meet technical, regulatory and manufacturing requirements.
* Works closely with other software, software QA, and hardware engineers to integrate, debug, and test systems.
* Participate in product design reviews.
* Perform other duties as required

  

  

**Basic Requirments:**

* Bachelor's degree in software engineering and at least 5 years of relevant work experience, or a master's degree in related field and 3 years of relevant experience.
* Strong programming skills in C and/or C\+\+ is required.
* Hands\-on experience with Embedded Systems is required.
* Experience on processors like ARM, TI and MSP (or similar Embedded Systems/Microcontrollers) is required.

**Preferred Skills and Competencies:**

* Demonstrated knowledge of software design principles and embedded software development.
* Experience developing software for embedded microcontrollers.
* Knowledge of OS concepts, including threading, mutual exclusion, deadlocks, and interrupt service routines.
* Understanding of RTOS and real\-time systems.
* Strong object\-oriented programming experience.
* Experience designing, implementing, maintaining, and testing embedded software components.
* Knowledge of communication interfaces and protocols such as I2C, SPI, USB, Flash, and EEPROM.
* Experience with wireless communication protocols, including Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), is preferred.
* Familiarity with communication systems and wireless technologies.
* Experience working within Agile or other software development lifecycle methodologies.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics is a plus.
* Medical device industry experience is preferred.
  

**Physical Requirements:**  

* General office environment, may sit for long periods of time.
Additional Information:


\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Compensation \& Benefits:\&\#xa;\&\#xa;For U.S.\-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $105,500\.00 \- $158,225\.00\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:\&\#xa;• Medical, dental, and vision insurance\&\#xa;• 401(k) with company match\&\#xa;• Paid time off (PTO)\&\#xa;• And additional employee wellness programs\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Application Details:\&\#xa;This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.\&\#xa;To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education.
Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non\-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non\-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.
  

  

We are looking for highly motivated, performance\-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!


At Insulet Corporation all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer I
jobs.description:
**About SimpliSafe**



We're a high\-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.
  

  

We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state\-of\-the\-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.


**Why are we hiring?**



Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.


**What You'll Do:**



Primary Responsibilities Include:


* Support the design, testing, and documentation of security\-focused products under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Assist with analyzing design alternatives and help surface tradeoffs in performance, cost, or schedule to your team.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including mechanical, firmware, industrial design, sourcing, and product management on assigned tasks.
* Help execute the product development process from prototyping through testing, following direction from senior engineers on requirements, cost, and schedule targets.
* Build and run prototype tests, and help troubleshoot issues under supervision.
* Participate in design reviews with suppliers and manufacturing partners, and help prepare materials for those reviews.
* Escalate resource or knowledge gaps to your lead or manager.
* Assist with documentation for the Technical Requirements Document.
* Complete well\-defined engineering tasks and deliverables assigned by senior engineers or the engineering lead.
* Support risk identification within your assigned scope of work.
* Build foundational knowledge of emerging technologies, sensors, and manufacturing processes relevant to product design.
* Bring energy and curiosity to your work and ask questions to grow quickly.


**What You'll Bring:**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* 1\+ years of relevant industry experience (internships or co\-ops count).
* Coursework or project experience related to low\-power or battery\-operated electronics is a plus.
* Some exposure to designing, building, or testing electronic systems.
* Willingness to learn from and work closely with product management to understand customer needs.
* Strong communication skills and eagerness to learn from more experienced engineers.
* Basic familiarity with embedded systems concepts such as UART, SPI, I2C, USB, or similar interfaces is a plus.
* Exposure to RF technologies (Sub\-GHz, WiFi, BLE) is a plus but not required.
* A demonstrated bias for action and a strong desire to grow into a systems engineering role.
* **Travel:** Willing to travel to our manufacturing partners in China 1\-3 times per year.


**What Values You'll Share**


* Customer Obsessed \- Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long\-term relationships with them.
* Aim High \- Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
* No Ego \- Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
* One Team \- Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
* Lift As We Climb \- Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
* Lean \& Nimble \- Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.


**What We Offer**


* A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
* A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families *(For more information on our total rewards please* *click here**)*
* Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
* Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.


The target annual base pay range for this role is $70,700 to $94,300\.



This target annual base pay range represents our good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market\-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.



Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

jobs.description:
Brooks is a leading provider of automation solutions with over 40 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, offering precision robotics, integrated automation systems, and contamination control solutions that empower chip manufacturers worldwide. Our product portfolio includes a range of automation solutions, including robots, vacuum systems, and atmospheric robots for semiconductor manufacturing ( www.brooks.com ).


Are you looking for a place where you can be part of a transformation? Join us at Brooks Automation and be a part of a dynamic organization that is shaping the future of technology.


Senior Electrical Engineer
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

The Senior Electrical Engineer – Power Electronics will lead the design and development of **low\-cost, high\-efficiency coil driver amplifiers** for distributed motion control architectures.  



  

This position focuses on **current\-controlled power electronics systems** used to drive large arrays of electromagnetic actuators. The system architecture includes **FPGA\-based current loop control, PWM generation, and EtherCAT distributed communication networks** .  



  

The role will directly contribute to the development of a **scalable distributed coil control platform** , supporting applications such as levitation systems and next\-generation robotic actuation platforms.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Power Electronics Design**

* Design and develop **coil driver amplifiers** using half\-bridge and H\-bridge topologies
* Support systems operating at **DC bus voltages up to 200V**
* Optimize for **efficiency, cost, and reliability** in high\-volume applications
* Address observed prototype issues including:
	+ PCB reliability and component failures
	+ Noise in current feedback loops
	Interconnect robustness and serviceability  
	+

  

**Current Control System Development**

* Develop and optimize **closed\-loop current control systems** , including:
	+ Precision current sensing (shunt \+ amplifier)
	+ PI/PID control loops
	+ Low\-latency feedback control
* Ensure stable operation across:
	+ Wide variation in coil inductance
	Large numbers of independently controlled coils  
	+

  

**FPGA and Digital Control Integration**

* Implement or co\-develop:
	+ Current loop control algorithms on FPGA platforms
	+ High\-performance PWM generation
Interface with multi\-channel control architectures using:
Parallel or synchronous SPI communication  
* +

  

**Distributed System Architecture**

* Develop driver modules operating within a **distributed EtherCAT control network**
* Support scalable architectures capable of controlling:
	+ Tens to hundreds of actuators per subsystem
Collaborate with system teams on partitioning control between:
Central controllers and distributed driver nodes  
* +

  

**Hardware Development and Validation**

* Select and design:
	+ MOSFETs, gate drivers, and current sensing circuits
	+ Protection and filtering circuitry (snubbers, transient suppression)
* Lead PCB\-level implementation including layout guidance for:
	+ High\-current switching paths
	+ Noise\-sensitive analog measurement circuits
Define and execute design verification testing (DVT)  
* 

  

**Cost and Reliability Optimization**

* Design to meet aggressive cost targets:
* Drive design trade\-offs balancing:
	+ Performance
	+ Manufacturability
	+ Scalability
* Improve system KPIs including:
	+ Standby power consumption
	+ Thermal efficiency
	Mean time between failures (MTBF)  
	+

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering
* Minimum **8 years of experience** in power electronics design
* Strong expertise in:
	+ MOSFET\-based power stages (half/full bridge)
	+ Medium voltage DC systems (up to \~200V)
* Hands\-on experience with:
	+ Current sensing techniques (shunt, differential amplifiers)
	+ Control loop design (PI/PID)
* Experience designing systems for:
	+ EMI/EMC robustness
	+ Thermal performance
	Reliability and failure analysis  
	+

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with **FPGA\-based control systems** (e.g., Lattice, Xilinx, Zynq)
* Familiarity with:
	+ EtherCAT or distributed real\-time control networks
* Experience with:
	+ Motor drives (BLDC, SRM)
	+ Electromagnetic or multi\-coil actuator systems
* Experience in:
	+ High\-channel\-count control systems
	Real\-time embedded control architectures  
	+

  

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to lead complex hardware development efforts
* Cross\-functional collaboration across electrical, controls, and system engineering
Hands\-on troubleshooting and debugging capability  
* 

  

**Success Criteria**

* Demonstrated stable current control across multi\-coil systems
* Achievement of target cost per driver module
* Reduced noise and improved current feedback performance
Successful hardware validation and scalability demonstration  
* 

  

**Compensation**

Base Salary Range: $118,265\.18 USD to $160,005\.83 USD
Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.


This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
  

The Lead Systems Engineer is responsible for owning and driving the system\-level definition, integration, and verification of capital/hardware equipment. This role provides technical leadership across disciplines (hardware, software, firmware, mechanical, quality, manufacturing), ensures that system requirements are well\-defined and traceable, and leads the team to deliver compliant, robust, and customer\-focused solutions throughout the product lifecycle. This role will collaborate closely with the Quality Management System team to ensure compliance of the design history file with applicable standards and regulations.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **System Definition \& Architecture**
	+ Lead the definition of system requirements, use cases, and interfaces based on customer, business, and regulatory needs.
	+ Develop and maintain system architecture, subsystem breakdown, and control documents.
	+ Ensure proper requirements flow\-down and traceability from system to subsystems and components.
* **Technical Leadership**
	+ Serve as the primary technical point of contact for system\-level topics across cross\-functional teams.
	+ Provide technical support and guidance to cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment with system architecture and requirements.
	+ Lead technical reviews (requirements, design, integration, verification) and drive closure of actions and risks.
* **Integration \& Verification**
	+ Plan and lead system integration activities, including test strategy, test plans, and test execution at system level.
	+ Coordinate and perform system verification and validation to ensure compliance requirements and fitness for use.
	+ Analyze test results, lead troubleshooting, and drive root cause investigations and corrective actions.
* **Lifecycle \& Risk Management**
	+ Support product sustainability, including change impact assessments.
	+ Identify, track, and mitigate technical risks; support FMEA and other risk management activities.
	+ Collaborate with cross\-functional team to ensure design compliance, reliability, and sustainability.
* **Stakeholder \& Project Support**
	+ Collaborate with product management and marketing to translate customer needs into system capabilities.
	+ Contribute to project planning, effort estimation, milestones, and system\-level deliverables.
	+ Support regulatory submissions, audits, and customer interactions as the system technical owner.
* **Mentoring \& Continuous Improvement**
	+ Mentor junior systems and design engineers; promote best practices in systems engineering.
	+ Champion continuous improvement of requirements management, architecture, and verification processes and tools.

**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in systems engineering or equivalent multi\-disciplinary engineering role.
* Proven experience leading complex, cross\-functional technical projects or products.
* Hands\-on experience with requirements management, system architecture, and system integration/verification.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Master’s degree in Systems Engineering or related discipline.
* Experience in a regulated industry (e.g., medical devices, aerospace, automotive, industrial).
* Familiarity with systems engineering standards and practices (e.g., INCOSE, V\-model, MBSE, SysML, etc.).
* Experience with requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama, Polarion, etc.).

**Key Skills and Competencies**


* Strong system\-level thinking and ability to understand interactions across hardware, software, and mechanical components.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong leadership, influence, and communication skills across all organizational levels.
* Ability to drive alignment, make trade\-off decisions, and manage ambiguity.
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in parallel.

**So why join Hologic?**


We are committed to making Hologic the company where top talent comes to grow. For you to succeed, we want to enable you with the tools and knowledge required and so we provide comprehensive training when you join as well as continued development and training throughout your career. We offer a competitive salary and an annual bonus scheme, one of our talent partners can discuss this in more detail with you.


If you have the right skills and experience and want to join our team, apply today. We can’t wait to hear from you!


The annualized base salary range for this role is $97,600 \- $152,700 and is bonus eligible. Final compensation packages will ultimately depend on factors including relevant experience, skillset, knowledge, geography, education, business needs and market demand.

**Who we are**


With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

**What we need**


We are looking for a Senior Manager of Electronic Hardware Engineering to join our Electrical Engineering – Bot Hardware team within our Hardware Engineering organization. Your job will be to provide hands\-on technical leadership while building and developing a high\-performing electrical hardware engineering team. You will bring deep expertise in digital and power electronics, guide complex products from concept through launch, and ensure our designs meet rigorous safety, quality, and compliance standards.

**What we do**


The Electrical Engineering – Bot Hardware team is part of the Hardware Engineering organization, which develops the technology behind Symbotic’s robotic systems. Our team owns the PCB\-based electronic hardware used within these systems, partnering across engineering disciplines to deliver solutions that support safe, reliable, and high\-performing robotic operation.

**What** **you’ll** **do**

* Provide hands\-on technical leadership in the architecture, design, development, and validation of advanced digital and power electronic systems, with a primary focus on PCBs.
* Guide system architecture, hardware requirements, design reviews, and technical trade\-off decisions for complex electronic systems.
* Remain hands\-on in PCB bring\-up, electrical validation, root\-cause analysis, and troubleshooting of complex developmental and field issues.
* Establish scalable engineering processes, design standards, review practices, and validation methods that improve hardware quality and execution.
* Develop and mentor a team of electrical hardware engineers while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, compliance, and technical excellence.
* Collaborate with software, firmware, mechanical, reliability, suppliers, and manufacturing partners to support seamless integration and successful product delivery.
* Oversee products from concept through production and market launch, including up to 25% travel to support project, supplier, business, and customer needs.
**What** **you’ll** **need**

* Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* At least 10 years of experience in electrical hardware design, including a minimum of three years in a technical leadership or people\-management role.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in complex PCB design, including digital and power electronics, high\-speed interfaces, power delivery, signal integrity, and power integrity.
* Demonstrated expertise in EMC, electrical compliance, and product safety requirements, including experience designing and validating hardware against applicable global standards; familiarity with European CE requirements is preferred.
* Experience with PCB bring\-up, electrical validation, compliance testing, and hands\-on troubleshooting of complex hardware and system\-level issues.
* Proven ability to build and develop engineering teams, establish effective hardware\-development processes, and deliver complex projects against demanding timelines.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines and external partnerships.

**Our environment**

* Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.
* Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued.

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (Mechanical Systems & Integration)
jobs.description:
\*\*This is a hybrid role out of our Methuen, MA location

**A Day in Your Life at MKS:**


As an Automation Engineer you will support the development of automation solutions for new and existing products across business units \& global production sites in our Vacuum Systems Division.


In this role, you will collaborate with manufacturing and automation professionals in the development of automation solutions that enable the production of high tolerance instrumentation products, improving efficiency, cost, quality, and capacity in our global factories. This role will be a key member of the Operations Automation Team reporting to the Automation Project Manager.

**You Will Make an Impact By:**

* Designing, specifying, and integrating automated mechanical systems including motion systems, end\-of\-arm tooling, fixturing, conveyors, part handling solutions, and machine subsystems.
* Developing machine concepts, layouts, and detailed designs using CAD tools (SolidWorks) while collaborating closely with system design, controls, and robotics engineers.
* Selecting and integrating motors, actuators, gearboxes, linear motion components, bearings, sensors, pneumatics, and safety devices into automated equipment.
* Supporting machine design reviews, prototyping, assembly, startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.
* Leading the integration, startup, verification, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automated machine solutions
* Designing and executing experiments, prototypes, and proof\-of\-concept studies to evaluate new automation technologies, machine concepts, motion systems, and manufacturing processes.
* Collaborating with automation professionals in other divisions to align on best practices, automation standards, and control frameworks that accelerate implementation of automation solutions across global factories and production supercenters

 **Skills You Bring:**

* BS degree in an engineering discipline such as Mechanical Eng, Mechatronics, or Industrial Eng
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and implementing automated manufacturing systems
* Hands\-on experience integrating and troubleshooting a wide variety of field devices, including sensors (photoelectric, proximity, vision), pneumatic and hydraulic components, variable frequency drives (VFDs), robots, and servo motors
* Demonstrated ability to create and read electrical schematics, design control panels, and implement industrial safety circuits (e.g., E\-stops, light curtains, safety relays).
* Excellent ability to articulate technical concepts, project status, and troubleshooting efforts clearly to both technical and non\-technical team members, including the Automation Project Manager and production staff
* Must be able to work closely with the Senior System Design Engineer to ensure seamless integration of sensors and actuators, and with the Robot \& Controls Engineer to synchronize controls with robot motion and tasks
* Familiarity with industrial networking protocols (EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, etc.) and automated data collection systems (SCADA, MES) a plus
* Demonstrated ability to design experiments, collect and analyze data, and make engineering recommendations based on quantitative results.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Salary Pay Range**: $ 75,000\.00 \- 110,000\.00 per year. This range is a good faith estimate of the expected salary range for this position, based on a wide range of factors including qualifications, experience and training, operational and business needs and other considerations permitted by law.

**Bonus**: This position is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, in an amount to be determined by MKS \[or as applicable].

**Benefits**: MKS offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance coverage (medical, dental and vision), 401(k) with company match, life and disability insurance, 12 paid holidays, sick time, 15 paid vacation days, \[6 weeks fully paid] parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition reimbursement \[and for participation in any stock programs, signing bonus, etc.


Globally, our policy is to recruit individuals from wide and diverse backgrounds. However, certain positions require access to controlled goods and technologies subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Applicants for these positions may need to be “U.S. persons.” “U.S. persons” are generally defined as U.S. citizens, noncitizen nationals, lawful permanent residents (or, green card holders), individuals granted asylum, and individuals admitted as refugees.


MKS Inc. and its affiliates and subsidiaries (“MKS”) is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer: diverse candidates are encouraged to apply. We win as a team and are committed to recruiting and hiring qualified applicants regardless of race, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and pregnancy\-related conditions), religion, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability or handicap, marital status, membership in the uniformed services, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other category protected by applicable law. Hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications and business needs. We conduct background checks and drug screens, in accordance with applicable law and company policies. MKS is generally only hiring candidates who reside in states where we are registered to do business.


It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.


MKS is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process due to a disability, please contact us at: accommodationsatMKS@mksinst.com

jobs.description:
**Mission of the Role**
-----------------------

**This position will be located at our Bloomington, MN or Canton, MA office.**


The Software Engineer II plays a key role in designing, developing, testing, and supporting software solutions across the full lifecycle of SICK products and platforms. Operating with increased independence, this role drives technical execution across development projects, enhances software performance and reliability, and contributes to the advancement of SICK’s software ecosystem. The Software Engineer II collaborates closely with global, cross‑functional teams and supports strategic technology initiatives \- delivering high‑quality, scalable, and secure solutions aligned with SICK’s technology vision.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Software Development**

* Independently execute software design, development, and implementation tasks following SICK’s development processes, including compliance with design control, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead enhancements, maintenance, and release activities across the software lifecycle, including major and minor versions, patches, updates, and long\-term support.
* Develop prototypes, proofs of concept, and MVPs to validate new ideas and de‑risk project uncertainties.
* Collaborate with internal and external development partners to meet technical, cost, and schedule expectations.
* Provide technical input during requirements refinement and architectural discussions.

**Testing \& Quality Assurance**

* Plan, design, and execute comprehensive test procedures to validate functionality, performance, reliability, and security.
* Conduct and sometimes lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to best practices, coding guidelines, and secure development standards.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex software issues, proposing short‑term fixes and long‑term systemic improvements.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Quality teams to translate technical requirements into actionable development tasks.
* Contribute to backlog refinement, estimation, and risk identification during project planning.
* Communicate technical decisions, project updates, and risk mitigation strategies clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Create, maintain, and review technical documentation including design specifications, test plans, change logs, and release notes.
* Support software change management and release documentation processes.

**Continuous Improvement \& Learning**

* Proactively maintain expertise in SICK platforms, technologies, and development tools.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, frameworks, and development practices that support innovation and efficiency.
* Mentor Software Engineer I team members through informal coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to process and product improvement initiatives.

**Machine Vision, Algorithms \& Emerging Technologies**

* Design, implement, and optimize classical and machine‑learning‑based algorithms for detection, inspection, automation, classification, tracking, and prediction using SICK 2D/3D cameras and programmable devices.
* Employ advanced techniques—such as deep learning—to enhance system accuracy, robustness, and scalability.
* Partner with internal teams to evaluate machine vision use cases and develop high‑value solutions.
* Maintain knowledge of modern hardware technologies, vision software frameworks, and AI/ML toolchains.
* Perform full engineering responsibilities including estimation, requirement analysis, technical risk assessment, and solution design.


Perform other duties as may be assigned or required by management.

----------------------

* **Experience**: 2\+ years of software development experience.
* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience is required.
* **Position\-specific Qualifications**:
	+ Strong problem‑solving, debugging, algorithmic thinking, and system design abilities.
	+ Solid understanding of data structures, design patterns, and modern software engineering principles.
	+ Proficiency in programming languages such as C\+\+, Python, or Lua, with the ability to work across multiple languages as needed.
	+ Demonstrated experience with multithreading, multiprocessing, inter‑process communication, networking, or distributed systems.
	+ Experience with version control (Git), code review workflows, CI/CD, and issue\-tracking systems.
	+ Familiarity with web fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, REST/JSON, HTTP) and ability to develop simple UI tools or prototypes.
	+ Ability to evaluate, integrate, and optimize third‑party or open\-source software components.
	+ Experience monitoring, optimizing, and improving system performance and stability.
	+ Experience designing or deploying machine vision / computer vision systems, including image processing or AI/ML\-based methods.
	+ Exposure to training or operationalizing deep learning models.
	+ Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.
	+ Strong communication skills with the ability to share technical information effectively across teams.
* **Language**: Professional written and spoken fluency in English required.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in C\+\+, Go, or Python.
* 3 years of experience in distributed systems, operating systems, or low\-level software ( e.g., experience with Linux).
* 3 years of experience in computer architecture, server hardware, networking (e.g., switches, routers), or out\-of\-band management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience with large compute fleet management(physical or virtual).
* Experience with Linux systems administration.
* Experience with networking operations.
* Knowledge of algorithms and data structures.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.  

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

  

For over 70 years, RTX BBN Technologies (BBN) has solved challenging problems through research, exploration, development, and prototyping. BBN’s Non\-Kinetic Capabilities and Technologies (NCT) team leverages computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, math, and physics to tackle customer challenges in electromagnetic warfare (EW), communications, cybersecurity, cyberspace operations, networking, and RF domains for the U.S. Department of War (DoW) and Intelligence Community (IC) customers.

  

BBN is looking for creative, entrepreneurial, and highly motivated, scientists, engineers, and developers who want to create, contribute to, and grow cutting\-edge research projects for system development, including advanced networking, offensive and defensive cyber, and EW operations.

**Job Title**: Embedded Systems Engineer **Job Summary**
System Level owner to lead the integration, configuration, and validation of embedded software within MCU\-based automotive controllers. This role operates at the intersection of firmware, controls (model\-based development), and vehicle integration, ensuring software is correctly built, configured, and validated for production release. The System Engineer is responsible for facilitating the integration of the mechanical, electrical and control systems of a propulsion or driveline system. Responsibilities include but are not limited to identifying, defining, and characterizing the connections between these systems and executing the functional, performance, and safety goals.

 **Responsibility*** Integrate firmware, middleware, application software, and configuration data into complete ECU builds.
* Own build generation, versioning, and release packaging across multiple vehicle programs.
* Maintain and improve build systems, integration scripts, and continuous integration / continuous development pipelines.
* Validate memory layouts, software configurations, and calibration data prior to release.
* Ensure alignment between software branches, feature content, and vehicle program milestones.
* Integrate model\-based functional software components into production ECU software.
* Ensure proper definition and implementation of software interfaces across application, middleware, and hardware layers.
* Collaborate with controls engineers to integrate and validate auto\-coded algorithms (Simulink/Coder).
* Support software architecture integration, whether AUTOSAR\-based or custom platforms.
* Verify correct interaction between control algorithms, drivers, and system services.
* Support software in lab, HIL, and vehicle environments.
* Validate end\-to\-end system behavior including bootloaders, diagnostics, and communication stacks (CAN\-FD/LIN/SPI).
* Troubleshoot integration issues across firmware, controls algorithms, and hardware interfaces.
* Support ECU flashing, software updates, and vehicle\-level deployment activities.
* Partner with calibration and vehicle teams to resolve issues identified during testing.
* Work closely with firmware, controls, hardware, validation, and systems engineering teams.
* Ensure all software inputs (code, models, configs, calibrations) are aligned and integration ready.
* Support interface alignment, feature integration, and system\-level behavior consistency.
* Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams on software deliverables and integration dependencies.
* Investigate integration failures, ECU instability, communication issues, and unexpected system behavior.
* Perform log analysis, trace debugging, and diagnostic evaluation (CAN traces, DTCs, etc.).
* Drive root cause analysis across software layers and system interfaces.
* Track defects and ensure resolution through cross\-team coordination.
* Manage software baselines, version control, and traceability from development through production.
* Maintain configuration management practices aligned with ALM tools (e.g., Polarion or similar).
* Ensure proper documentation of releases, feature content, and known issues.
* Support change management and impact analysis across integrated systems.

  

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of this position and it is not intended to be an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Academic/Educational Requirements**
Four\-year degree in engineering or technology related field from an accredited Institution and 5 \- 10\+ years of experience in embedded software integration, development, or validation.

**Required Skills/Experience**

* Strong understanding of embedded systems and software architecture, including real\-time systems, application software integration, bootloaders and flashing, diagnostics (UDS, DTCs), and automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet).
* Experience integrating software into MCU\-based automotive controllers (ECUs).
* Familiarity with model\-based development (MATLAB/Simulink, Coder) and auto\-code integration.
* Ability to understand control algorithms and their interaction with hardware and vehicle systems.
* Hands\-on experience with build systems, scripting, or automation (Python, shell, CI/CD tools).
* Strong debugging and system\-level root cause analysis skills.
* Experience supporting software bring\-up in lab, HIL, and vehicle environments.
* Familiarity with configuration management and ALM tools.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills across cross\-functional teams.

Mid\-Level Controls Engineer

**Company:** Automated Machine Systems (AMS)  
**Department:** Controls Engineering  
**Reports To:** Controls Engineering Manager / Director of Controls  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Position Summary

Automated Machine Systems (AMS) is seeking a Mid\-Level Controls Engineer to design, program, commission, and support industrial automation systems.

This position is intended for an engineer who has developed a solid foundation in industrial controls and is capable of taking ownership of the controls portion of a project with limited supervision. The Controls Engineer will work closely with mechanical engineering, project management, assembly, customers, and other members of the controls team to deliver reliable and maintainable automation systems.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working both independently and as part of a project team, can troubleshoot equipment methodically, and is capable of supporting equipment from initial design through programming, testing, installation, startup, and ongoing customer support.

Primary ResponsibilitiesControls Design \& Development

* Develop PLC programs for industrial automation and material\-handling equipment.
* Develop and modify HMI applications.
* Configure and integrate VFDs, servo systems, remote I/O, sensors, safety devices, and other industrial control components.
* Develop machine sequences, interlocks, permissives, alarms, and fault\-recovery logic.
* Assist with electrical control system design and component selection.
* Review electrical drawings and provide feedback or corrections prior to panel construction and machine assembly.
* Develop controls systems that are organized, maintainable, and consistent with AMS programming standards.
* Participate in controls design reviews and project planning.

Machine Integration \& Testing

* Bring up and test controls systems during machine assembly.
* Perform I/O checkout and verify proper operation of sensors, actuators, motors, safety devices, and communication networks.
* Debug machine sequences and identify electrical, programming, mechanical, or application\-related problems.
* Work directly with mechanical engineering and assembly personnel to resolve equipment issues.
* Participate in internal machine testing and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Camgian is hiring a Senior QA Software Engineer to join our team in **Starkville, MS**. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role reporting to Camgian's Quality Assurance Director. You will lead the design, implementation, and execution of manual and automated test strategies for software, firmware, and hardware across Camgian's product lines while remaining active in code, automation, and difficult defect investigations. We are particularly interested in an engineer who built a strong foundation as a software developer and deliberately chose to focus on software quality because they value the investigative, systems\-oriented work of testing. You will enter a developing QA organization and will be expected to quickly assess its people, practices, coverage, and tooling; coach team members who demonstrate aptitude and commitment; and partner with the QA Director to close remaining capability and staffing gaps. This position offers the opportunity to work on state\-of\-the\-art products supporting defense and industrial missions, in both office and outdoor environments. Camgian builds AI\-enabled decision automation and cognitive computing platforms including kill chain automation, sensor fusion, and air and missile defense capabilities to deliver real\-time, mission\-critical intelligence to warfighters and industrial operators. Success will be measured by earlier defect detection, expanded reliable automation, fewer escaped defects, repeatable release evidence, and a stronger, more capable QA team.
  

  

**Qualifications**
* United States Citizen
* 7\+ years of combined software development and QA/software test engineering experience, including at least 3 years focused on quality/test and experience operating at a senior or technical\-lead level
* BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience
* Demonstrated foundation as a hands\-on software developer, with evidence of designing, coding, debugging, and shipping production software before moving into or expanding responsibilities in QA and software test engineering
* Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Appium, pytest, TestNG, Robot Framework)
* Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Java, C\#, C\+\+, or Go), with the ability to read and debug production code and build maintainable test automation, simulators, and internal tooling
* Experience in integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
* Experience with API testing and tooling (e.g., Postman, REST Assured)
* Strong working knowledge of the full software development lifecycle and Agile/Scrum methodology
* Experience testing across multiple platforms and form factors (Android, Windows, embedded/firmware, cloud computing, laptop/handheld/tablet hardware)
* Demonstrated ability to assess, mentor, and raise the performance of junior and mid\-level QA engineers, supported by specific examples of improved team capability or delivery outcomes

**Desired Skills**
* Experience testing embedded systems, firmware, or hardware in a defense, industrial, or aerospace context
* Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., TestRail, Zephyr, Jira)
* Experience with performance, load, or stress testing tools and methodology
* Working knowledge of security testing principles and secure coding practices
* Experience standing up or materially improving QA processes, automation frameworks, and team practices for a new or developing product line
* Active or previously held security clearance

**Key Responsibilities**

The Controls Engineer is responsible for the design, development, integration, validation, and support of electrical and control systems for automated manufacturing equipment and industrial automation projects. This role develops machine controls solutions from concept through implementation while ensuring systems are reliable, safe, maintainable, and aligned with customer and operational requirements.


The position works closely with Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing, Setup, and Project Management teams to support successful project execution, equipment commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support activities. Controls Engineers contribute to all phases of the automation lifecycle including design, programming, documentation, integration, validation, startup, and field support.


This role also supports continuous improvement initiatives, evaluates emerging technologies, and contributes to development of standardized engineering practices and operational efficiencies across MMCC’s automation systems and product offerings.

  



**Controls Design \& Engineering**

* Design electrical, pneumatic, and fluid control systems for automated manufacturing equipment and industrial automation projects.
* Develop electrical schematics, control layouts, and machine documentation utilizing engineering design software.
* Design and program PLC, HMI, robot, drive, and safety control systems.
* Prepare technical documentation, specifications, bills of material, and supporting engineering documentation.
* Develop and validate control system architectures to ensure safe and reliable machine operation.
* Collaborate with Mechanical Engineering and other technical disciplines to support integrated automation solutions.
* Research and evaluate new technologies, control methods, and automation solutions to support operational and product development initiatives.

**Integration, Validation \& Troubleshooting**

* Support manufacturing and controls installation activities throughout equipment build and integration processes.
* Integrate, validate, and troubleshoot machine controls, robotic systems, safety circuits, and automation equipment.

**Safety \& Continuous Improvement**

* Support compliance with electrical, machine safety, and guarding standards including OSHA, A3/RIA, NFPA, ANSI, and related requirements.

We also move fast. Wright is an all\-hands, high\-ownership environment where the pace is quick and the problems are hard, and the people who thrive here are the ones who dig in and drive their work to the finish. At the same time, we know sustained great work depends on rest: we respect our team's personal time and protect the boundaries that keep people sharp, healthy, and here for the long haul.
