jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are building Kernel to power instant, simple payments across healthcare.

Healthcare providers spend enormous amounts of time navigating insurance portals, practice\-management systems, phone calls, claims, denials, payments, and reconciliation just to get paid for care they have already delivered.

**We think much of this work can and should be done by machines.**

Kernel is an always\-on system that operates across the software healthcare practices already use. Our agents navigate practice\-management systems and payer portals, call insurance companies, verify coverage, submit and recover claims, reconcile payments, and increasingly handle the entire path from care delivered to money collected.

We are starting with dental practices and building toward a much larger goal: making healthcare payments simple.

**The role**

We are looking for an exceptional engineer to join the founding team in New York.

You will work directly with the founders and own major pieces of Kernel from idea to production. This is not a narrowly scoped engineering role. You might spend one week building an agent that operates legacy healthcare software, the next improving our verification infrastructure across thousands of sessions, and the next shipping a new payments product directly to clinics. **We are looking for an exceptional engineer to join the founding team and help us push these systems toward true autonomy.**

**What you'll build**

You will work directly with the founders on some of the hardest technical problems at Kernel.

This may include:

* Building computer\-use and browser agents that reliably operate legacy healthcare software
* Training and improving models for healthcare\-specific actions and reasoning
* Building post\-training pipelines using SFT, reinforcement learning, synthetic data, and production traces
* Designing rigorous evals for long\-horizon agent behavior
* Improving reliability across workflows that may require hundreds of actions and multiple external systems
* Building model\-routing, inference, context, memory, and tool\-use infrastructure
* Turning millions of real\-world agent interactions into training data
* Building voice agents that communicate with insurance companies
* Working with multimodal models across screens, documents, faxes, forms, and structured data
* Reducing inference cost and latency while increasing task success
* Building the product and infrastructure necessary to deploy these systems across thousands of healthcare practices

**Who we're looking for**

We care much more about what you can build than where you went to school or how many years you have worked.

You may be a strong fit if you:

* You are an exceptional programmer
* You have unusually high technical ambition
* You learn new systems very quickly
* You have built serious projects outside of assigned work
* You enjoy debugging problems where there is no Stack Overflow answer
* You are comfortable moving between ML, infrastructure, product, and systems work
* You want ownership rather than narrowly scoped tickets
* You care about both speed and engineering quality
* You want to work intensely with a small team in person in New York
* You enjoy making things

We are open to exceptional new graduates and early\-career engineers.

We are also open to candidates from traditional ML, systems, infrastructure, robotics, compilers, distributed systems, or other technically demanding backgrounds if they can demonstrate exceptional ability.

**How we work**

Milo is a small engineering team in Manhattan. Engineers here do not sit several layers away from the problem.

You might talk to a customer in the morning, inspect an agent failure, modify the runtime, run an experiment, and deploy the fix that afternoon.

We expect engineers to own problems end to end.

There are very few meetings, very little bureaucracy, and a very high bar for what we build.

**Why Milo**

AI is becoming capable of doing work, not just generating text. Healthcare is one of the largest industries in the world, but much of its financial infrastructure still depends on people manually moving information between fragmented systems.

We think that changes over the next decade.

Our goal is to build the autonomous infrastructure that gets healthcare providers paid.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years solving, we'd like to meet you.

**Application**

Please include:

**1\. The most technically ambitious thing you have built.**  
Tell us what you personally built and include a link if possible.

**2\. Your experience with modern ML systems.**  
This could include agents, model training, post\-training, reinforcement learning, evals, inference, multimodal models, or ML infrastructure.

**3\. A difficult technical problem you encountered.**  
What was breaking, how did you diagnose it, and what did you change?

**4\. Why Milo?**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Happy hour
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Snacks provided
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**Job Requirements**


The New Product Development (NPD) – Refrigeration Systems Engineer will play a key role in product support and strategic development: supporting HVAC cooling and heat pump equipment development, developing qualification plans for systems and components, secure product requirement compliance and agency certification.

  

Based onsite in Syracuse, NY, this position operates on a Monday through Friday day shift schedule.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Product cost productivity (Sch B) for Light Commercial and Commercial products
* Support the development of strategic customer options across multiple product lines
* Provide engineering support for field quality issues reported, offering effective solutions to improve product quality with a competitive cost in a timely manner.

* Support product ETL/UL audits through plants and maintain accuracy agency files.

* Develop and coordinate engineering documents and release.
* Provide daily direction to supporting Designers \& Technicians.
* Prepare presentations for Qualification Review Boards including demonstrating the use of Quality System deployment tools.
* Collaborate with team members from Marketing, Design Engineering, and Manufacturing Engineering.
* Document process improvements as part of standard engineering work.
* Identification of reliable and cost\-effective purchased components required for new product development projects

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering field with 2\+ years of experience working with specification, design, development, and manufacture of products in an engineering environment, **\-or\-** Master’s degree in an Engineering field with 1\+ years of experience working with specification, design, development, and manufacture of products in an engineering environment.
* 1\+ years of experience working with refrigeration design, heat transfer, fan systems, structural analysis and/or electronic control systems.
* Able and willing to travel up to 10% of the year domestically and to Mexico to support field sites and travel to manufacturing facilities.
* Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the USA. No visa sponsoring available.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Systems Engineering.
* Experience or familiarity with various HVAC applications or similar industry.
* Hands\-on experience working in an Engineering design environment.
* Demonstrated system design thinking skills and creative new product design skills.
* Project management and interpersonal skills and the ability to work within an engineering design team
* Experience in system control development
* Experience with vapor\-compression refrigeration or power generation systems including related components: heat exchangers and compression technologies.
* Experience integrating and verifying \& validating performance of complex systems
* Knowledge of CSA/ANSI and UL Standards such as: AHRI, ASHRAE, DOE, EPA, NEC, UL/CSA, etc.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing fabrication and assembly methods.
* Demonstrated experience in continual process improvement.
* Experience with model\-based design techniques.
* Ability to work with geographically dispersed teams and a diverse cultural environment.
* Ability to professionally engage with cross\-functional and cross\-regional teams to understand and translate product requirements into control system requirements.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts across technical and non\-technical organizations.
* Ability for developing continuous improvement projects to influence and drive change.
* Excellent Follow\-up and follow\-through skills.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail, while managing multiple priorities.

**Pay Range**


The annual salary for this position is between $64,500\.00 \- $129,500\.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.**Other Compensation**


This position may be entitled to short\-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.**Benefits**


Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation

jobs.title: Entry Level Software Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

The BAE Systems GXP Software Team, based in Durham NC near Research Triangle Park, is seeking highly motivated entry level software engineers to join our team. We are looking for candidates that will enjoy developing unique, cutting\-edge solutions that help people make sense of exquisite imagery, video, and other sophisticated remote sensor data. We value those who are curious to explore the "what", "when", "how", and "why" of world events using advanced technologies. We encourage attitudes towards problem solving driven by persistence, innovation, teamwork and a willingness to meet challenges head on.
  

  

Our team develops state\-of\-the art software for sensor\-data processing, analysis, storage, and visualization for challenging problems in the areas of video analytics, image processing, and other temporal data sources. We utilize the most advanced techniques for data science, machine learning, computer vision, statistical analysis, and cloud computing to discover hidden patterns in big data. We develop end\-to\-end applications that process data for desktop, web, embedded platforms, and large scale cloud computing environments. We believe collaboration is key, as such, you will be paired with a mentor to facilitate a smooth onboarding process as you become familiar with our products and the technologies we employ.
  

  

Our commercial software products include:
* GXP InMotion Server \- ingests and streams real\-time data feeds, providing recording and analytics capabilities
* GXP InMotion Desktop \- video and image analysis application
* Track Analytics Software Suite (TASS) \- a suite of algorithms for analyzing geospatial data
* MOVINT Database \- a geospatial big\-data store with RESTful web service interfaces
* GXP InMotion Web / MOVINT\- a browser\-based front end for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data

You can read more about our software and solutions here:
  

InMotion Desktop and Server \- https://www.geospatialexploitationproducts.com/content/gxpinmotion/
  

MOVINT Solutions \- https://www.geospatialexploitationproducts.com/content/movint/
  

  

As a member of our software group, you will contribute to a highly\-motivated small team responsible for software development and data analysis for client\-driven programs, and the integration of these technologies into core BAE Systems products and customer platforms. The ideal candidate enjoys learning in a challenging technical environment; collaborating on multiple teams and projects; and can apply their technical skill and innovation towards solving real\-world problems.
  

  

Because this role involves a combination of collaborative/in\-person and independent work, it will take the form of a hybrid work format, with time split between working onsite and remotely.  

  

  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science
* Must be eligible for a US TS/SCI security clearance
* Knowledge and experience Python, Java, C\+\+, or JavaScript (any)

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT KRAKEN KINETICS**


Kraken Kinetics designs and manufactures advanced kinetic solutions that enable modern warfighting capabilities for the United States Armed Forces and its allies. We specialize in mission\-tailored warheads and firing systems for unmanned and autonomous weapon platforms, delivering production\-ready solutions at speed to address urgent national security challenges.


Our team brings decades of specialized Department of War experience across the full lifecycle of kinetic system development—from concept and design through testing, manufacturing, and operational deployment. Built on a foundation of work that helped lead the DoW into the era of kinetic drones, Kraken Kinetics combines commercial agility with deep technical expertise to deliver **DEFINITIVE LETHALITY**when it matters most.

**Position Summary**


Kraken Kinetics is seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to support the development and maturation of advanced defense products within a small, fast\-moving engineering organization.


This is a hands\-on execution role. The Senior Systems Engineer will work directly across mechanical, electrical, firmware, test, manufacturing, and program functions to translate customer and operational needs into clear system requirements, interfaces, verification strategies, and technical baselines. The role will remain closely involved in day\-to\-day engineering execution and product development rather than operating primarily in a strategic or advisory capacity.


In addition to direct systems engineering work, this position will provide technical mentorship to less\-experienced systems engineering personnel and help strengthen Kraken’s systems engineering practices as the organization grows. This includes establishing practical requirements structures, traceability approaches, review practices, verification methods, and technical documentation that improve engineering clarity without adding unnecessary process burden.


A key near\-term responsibility will be helping implement and mature Jama Connect as Kraken’s requirements management platform. The Senior Systems Engineer will help establish effective project structures, requirements hierarchies, traceability relationships, review workflows, verification linkages, templates, and basic administration practices that support ongoing engineering execution.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Develop, capture, decompose, allocate, and maintain system\-level requirements derived from customer needs, operational use cases, internal product objectives, statements of work, applicable standards, and engineering constraints.
* Work with mechanical, electrical, firmware, test, manufacturing, and program personnel to ensure requirements are clear, testable, technically appropriate, and actionable.
* Develop and maintain requirements traceability, verification matrices, interface control documentation, system architecture artifacts, and related technical baselines.
* Support system architecture development, interface definition, trade studies, technical risk assessment, and system\-level engineering decisions.
* Identify requirement gaps, conflicts, assumptions, dependencies, and technical risks early and work with stakeholders to drive resolution.
* Coordinate with test and verification personnel to define verification methods, acceptance criteria, test coverage, and traceability between requirements and objective evidence.
* Support design reviews, test readiness reviews, production readiness reviews, failure investigations, and other technical reviews.
* Support development of compliance matrices, verification evidence, customer\-facing technical documentation, and other controlled engineering artifacts.
* Help maintain alignment between requirements, system architecture, detailed engineering development, verification, and configuration\-controlled product baselines.
* Provide technical mentorship to less\-experienced systems engineering personnel, including guidance on requirements development, traceability, interface definition, verification planning, and system\-level problem solving.
* Help mature practical systems engineering processes, templates, review practices, and documentation standards appropriate for Kraken’s size, products, and stage of growth.
* Support the implementation and ongoing maturation of Jama Connect as Kraken’s requirements management platform.
* Develop and maintain Jama Connect project structures, requirements hierarchies, traceability relationships, verification linkages, review workflows, baselines, and reusable templates.
* Support basic Jama Connect configuration and administration, including project organization, permissions, relationship rules, and governance practices as needed.
* Help establish consistent engineering practices for using Jama Connect across product development efforts.
* Provide guidance and training to engineering personnel on effective requirements development and use of the requirements management environment.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
* 5\+ years of relevant engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on experience performing systems engineering activities on complex products or systems.
* Demonstrated experience developing, decomposing, allocating, and managing technical requirements.
* Working knowledge of requirements traceability, interface management, verification planning, technical baselines, and engineering review processes.
* Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines, including some combination of mechanical, electrical, firmware/software, test, manufacturing, and program functions.
* Experience applying systems engineering practices in a defense, aerospace, high\-reliability, safety\-critical, or similarly structured engineering environment.
* Ability

* Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC programs (primarily Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000\).
* Develop and maintain HMI applications using modern high‑performance HMI standards (ISA‑101 preferred).
* Support VFD setup, tuning, communication, and diagnostics.
* Ensure controls logic is robust, well\-structured, and compliant with internal standards (UDTs, AOIs, modular code).
* Maintain accurate documentation including PLC backups, wiring schematics for production lines, network drawings, and change logs.
* Participate in root cause investigations and implement long\-term corrective actions through controls improvements.


**SCADA, Data \& Networking**


* Lead the development and deployment of the plant\-wide SCADA system, including system architecture, dashboard design, historian integration, and reliable data acquisition.
* Develop and maintain data models, tag naming conventions, and controls standards so information is organized consistently across machines, departments, and systems.
* Build and support the data pathways that translate machine behavior into clear, actionable information for operators, supervisors, and engineers — through well‑designed dashboards, trend views, reports, and visual tools that help teams understand performance, variation, and process behavior.
* Configure and support communication interfaces, including PLC\-to\-SCADA links, OPC UA, networked devices, and historian structures.
* Contribute to the design and upkeep of industrial network architecture, including Ethernet/IP topologies, managed switches, and segmentation practices aligned with plant needs.
* Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve system reliability, data clarity, and the speed at which information reaches the people who need it.
* Act as the primary technical resource for SCADA\- and data\-related decisions, ensuring system changes are documented and implemented in a controlled, maintainable manner.


**Project Engineering**


* Lead and support automation upgrades, controls retrofits, and new equipment installations.
* Write engineering specifications for controls requirements on new equipment.
* Review vendor control designs for compliance with plant standards.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, and integration planning.
* Support capital project justification and cost\-benefit analysis.


**Operations \& Maintenance Support**


* Serve as the technical escalation point for controls\-related downtime and operational issues.
* Partner with Maintenance to build troubleshooting capability and improve equipment reliability.
* Develop standard work, troubleshooting guides, and training materials for operators and technicians.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across safety, quality, uptime, throughput, and scrap.


**Safety, Compliance \& Standards**


* Ensure all control systems comply with electrical safety practices and applicable standards.
* Support arc\-flash documentation, safe work policies, and energy isolation procedures.
* Contribute to plant\-wide controls standards, cybersecurity practices, and change management processes.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related discipline.
* 3\+ years of hands‑on controls engineering experience in manufacturing.
* Proficiency with Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix \& CompactLogix, Studio 5000, Ethernet/IP.
* Experience developing and troubleshooting HMI software/hardware (FactoryTalk View, InTouch, Red Lion, Ignition, or similar).
* Strong understanding of industrial networks, IP addressing, managed switches, VLANs, and communication protocols.
* Experience with VFDs (setup, tuning, integration).
* Ability to read, create, and interpret electrical schematics, P\&IDs, and machine documentation.
* Strong problem‑solving, analytical, and root cause analysis skills.
* Ability to work effectively on the plant floor and support production needs.
* Knowledge and ability to work safely with control and power voltages / currents.


Preferred Qualifications


* Experience with historian systems (Wonderware, Ignition, OSI Pi, SQL\-based solutions).
* Experience with SQL queries, data structures, and basic scripting for automation (Python, VB, or similar).
* Familiarity with MES, OEE, downtime tracking, or manufacturing data systems.
* Experience implementing ISA‑101 (HMI) and ISA‑18\.2 (alarm management) practices.
* Experience leading automation projects and/or SCADA development in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.


**Work Environment / Physical Requirements**


* Frequent presence on the production floor.
* Ability to move safely around manufacturing equipment.
* Ability to work extended hours or respond to off\-shift issues when necessary.


**Why Join Us**


* Opportunity to shap

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the platform hardware, libraries, and operating system.

jobs.description:
**Electrical Controls Engineer**  

**Allied Mineral Products** is a leading manufacturer of monolithic refractories worldwide. We are seeking an **Electrical Controls Engineer**in our Columbus, Ohio location.
  

The plant engineering focus area for the Electrical Controls Engineer is to support the organization in the development and implementation of manufacturing information and automation strategy, defining projects and solutions applying technology, leveraging expertise in manufacturing process control and information systems. Will work closely with other engineering disciplines in development of new systems or refinement of existing equipment and processes.  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**
* Identify and integrate hardware/sensors, software, and data acquisition tools to develop and manage IoT/Industry 4\.0 applications for data analysis, preventive/predictive maintenance, quality and condition monitoring and performance improvements.
* Ensure data integrity for analysis and visualization solutions using software and programming languages such as SQL, Lab View, Ignition, and Microsoft Power BI.
* Extract and analyze data from multiple platforms and sources to develop and implement analytics reports and visualization toolsets. (Dashboards, OEE, etc.)
* Familiarity with and ability to use, program, and debug PLC, HMI, and robot software.
* Design and deploy manufacturing/operations equipment controls and data acquisition infrastructure in alignment with company’s network infrastructure standards
* For the manufacturing process network, lead equipment network asset management including the creation and maintenance of component inventory and documentation such as technical specifications information, network configuration, network mapping, processes, and change management.
* Develop, implement, and interpret process and instrumentation diagrams (P\&IDs) into schematics, PLC controls, and data acquisition plans.
* Coordinates activities between R\&D, Operations and IT.
* Function as the subject matter expert in both hardware and software for engineering systems for industrial manufacturing environment, Manage plant engineering projects, from beginning to end, including defining requirements, developing designs, cost estimates, and timelines, obtaining buy in from other parties, planning and supervising installations, tracking revisions, and producing final documentation.
* Responsible for the electrical controls aspects of the projects including hardware design, software design, design documentation, networking, data acquisition, equipment installation, equipment debug, and support
* Evaluates new and used equipment, designing electrical controls for equipment for plant and lab systems.
* Develop and implement control systems designs, including gathering requirements, performing calculations, PLC \& HMI programming, system validation, and implementation.
* Produce accurate mechanical and electrical drawings for layout, assembly, fabrication, and erection of equipment and facilities.
* Prepare specifications for bidding and purchasing of equipment, materials, supplies, and services.
* Coordinate outside contractors, as needed, to complete any assigned projects.
* Provide training and instruction to Maintenance and other Allied employees on updated system configurations, new equipment and applications, safety, and other topics.
* Provide timely support to troubleshoot hardware and software, identify issues with facilities and lab equipment, and implement solutions to prevent recurrence and improve equipment uptime.
* Maintain excellent lines of communication with Maintenance, Production, other Allied departments, and our affiliates.
* Support Allied’s manufacturing operations around the world. Occasional travel to US or international locations may be required.
* Independently maintain technical knowledge and remain current on emerging technologies.

**Qualifications**
* A Bachelors’ degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, IT, Physics or other similar technical field, or equivalent work experience required.
* At least 5 years of related work experience and prior work experience in a manufacturing environment a plus.
* Knowledge of industrial electrical controls, PLC programming, and power distribution systems.
* In depth understanding of applicable North America electrical codes and industry standards used in equipment design including but not limited to UL, NFPA, NEC and IEC.

jobs.description:
**Backend Systems Engineer, Industrial IoT Platforms**
======================================================

**Location:** Grandview Heights, OH

**Your week, at a glance**
--------------------------


On Monday morning, you sync with robotics and controls engineers to map new machine telemetry into ForgeNest’s Universal Operating System. By midweek, you’ve shipped a secure API that streams production data to a new dashboard and tuned a time‑critical data pipeline so operators get live insights on equipment status. Friday, you monitor system health in a live manufacturing cell, push a performance fix, and jump into a quick TypeScript/React tweak to ship a complete feature end‑to‑end.

**The impact you’ll have**
--------------------------

* Design and build reliable backend services and APIs that power ForgeNest’s next‑generation manufacturing platform.
* Model and manage machine, production, and operational data across SQL/NoSQL stores and durable pipelines.
* Integrate services with ForgeNest’s Universal Operating System, machine controllers, sensors, and third‑party tools.
* Deliver secure, scalable RESTful and event‑driven interfaces consumed by web apps and internal systems.
* Develop the backend logic and data services behind real‑time dashboards and visualization tools for operators and engineers.
* Collaborate closely with software, manufacturing, robotics, controls, and company leadership on architecture and requirements.
* Set patterns for service design, data architecture, and development standards that scale with our platform.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve performance and reliability in both dev and live manufacturing environments.
* Prototype new capabilities quickly based on feedback from customers, operators, and internal teams.
* Contribute to UI components when needed using JavaScript/TypeScript and React (or similar) to fully deliver features.

**Who thrives here**
--------------------

* A backend‑first engineer who’s comfortable touching the front end to finish a feature.
* Someone who enjoys translating physical processes into clean, dependable services and data systems.
* A strong communicator across software, manufacturing, robotics, and leadership.
* A builder motivated by resilient infrastructure powering real‑world systems.

**Experience we’re looking for**
--------------------------------

* Professional experience creating backend services, APIs, or distributed systems.
* Proficiency in one or more: Node.js, Python, Go, or Java.
* Hands‑on work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases and thoughtful data modeling.
* Building and integrating RESTful or event‑driven APIs.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and a UI framework such as React.
* Strong understanding of application architecture, service design, and state/data management.
* Experience with real‑time or data‑intensive systems (dashboards, telemetry, operational apps).
* Excellent debugging and problem‑solving across the stack.
* Collaborative experience within a software development team.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Ownership from concept through production.
* Comfort operating in a fast‑moving startup.
* Curiosity about manufacturing, robotics, industrial automation, and physical systems.
* Systems design instincts with a focus on reliability, scalability, and data integrity.
* Ability to communicate complex technical ideas simply.
* Willingness to pick up front‑end work when it helps the team.
* Bonus: experience with manufacturing software, industrial automation, robotics, machine interfaces, or real‑time systems.
* Bonus: message queues, streaming data, or time‑series databases.
* Valued: interest in AI‑enabled software for smarter manufacturing.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

* Rapid understanding of ForgeNest’s technology, backend architecture, and user workflows.
* Ownership of major backend systems that improve reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Establishing backend architecture and development standards that scale with our customers.
* APIs and services that make building robust interfaces straightforward.
* Becoming a trusted technical contributor as the platform and team grow.

**Why ForgeNest**
-----------------


ForgeNest is a venture‑backed startup building an AI‑driven, software‑forward forging platform to modernize a critical manufacturing industry. We pair commercial hardware with proprietary software, AI‑driven toolpath generation, and a next‑generation Universal Operating System to transform how forged metal parts are designed and manufactured across defense, aerospace, energy, maritime, and industrial markets.


Join a small, highly technical team developing dual‑use technology with real‑world impact—your work will directly shape the future of advanced manufacturing, automation, and industrial tech.

jobs.description:
**About REEcycle**

REEcycle is an American rare earth elements (REE) recycling company focused on recovering rare earths from end\-of\-life NdFeB magnets to bolster U.S. supply chain resilience and reduce dependence on foreign sources of critical minerals. Backed by U.S. Department of War funding, we are establishing production at our facility in Duncan, Oklahoma.

**About the Role**

As we scale toward commercial deployment, we are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to lead the team and optimize our proprietary systems. A key focus will be on the deployment, testing, and further build out of our Drive Disassembly Machine (DDM), a critical component to REEcycle’s future success. This system efficiently extracts magnets from hard disk drives, creating economically viable feedstocks for our processes.

We are looking for an energetic self\-starter who thrives in dynamic environments, brings inventive and solutions\-oriented thinking, and is ready to play a key role in building the future of U.S. rare earth independence.

If you're excited by the opportunity to lead engineering efforts at a high\-impact company with significant room for career advancement, we’d love to speak with you about our Senior Engineer position.

This is a full\-time, on\-site (not remote) position in Duncan, OK.

**Key Responsibilities**

Lead engineering team on scaling a Mechatronic System

* Lead and manage project and team across all aspects from R\&D to commercial scale implementation.
* Develop deep working knowledge of the company’s proprietary machinery, which integrates hydraulics, pneumatics, mechanical assemblies, and PLC\-based control systems.
* Serve as the primary internal engineering point of contact, being a thought leader and systems\-level problem\-solver across all technical aspects of the process and system.

Systems Integration and Troubleshooting

* Understand how the various mechanical and electrical sub\-systems interact, including solenoid valves, pneumatic actuators, linear guides, hydraulic pumps and cylinders, sensors, and control logic.
* When issues arise (e.g. unexpected machine behavior), lead root\-cause analysis and coordinate troubleshooting, drawing from hands\-on diagnostics, system logs, or vendor input as required.

Oversee and Coordinate External Technical Partners

* Manage the work of outside automation and systems integration firms, ensuring their deliverables align with system requirements, certification goals, and project timelines.
* Provide clear technical direction, evaluate engineering trade\-offs, and ensure that outsourced work aligns with the company’s product roadmap and constraints.
* Guide Commercialization and Production Readiness
* Lead efforts to evolve the current prototype into a commercially robust, scalable, and compliant system.
* Ensure the design meets manufacturing, field servicing, and certification requirements (e.g. UL, CE), including documentation, BOM finalization, and design\-for\-assembly.

Deployment and Field Learning

* Support and monitor deployments, ensuring field performance aligns with expectations.
* Capture real\-world feedback to inform design improvements and de\-risk future production runs.

jobs.description:
**About Treeswift:**


In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.


We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments.


Since our first pilot with a utility in June 2024, we've grown fast, now working with three of the five largest utilities in the US. To date, our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.


To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission\-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital.


We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia.


Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us.

**About the role**


As a senior robotics engineer you will drive outcomes across perception, mapping, sensor fusion and calibration that directly contribute to the expansion of our business. As our business grows these needs will change; first priorities for this role will include:

* **Improving the quality and consistency of our product in an increasing breadth of operating conditions.** For example, you will lead SLAM development including incorporating new sensor evolutions and exploring innovative approaches to improving performance in GPS degraded environments.
* **Accelerating our time to delivery by leveling up our sensor fusion and calibration.** This includes fusing multi\-user, multi\-session point cloud maps and automating alignment of LiDAR and imagery data to produce consistent large\-scale scenes.
* **Power scalability and reliability** by eliminating the need for extrinsic measurements on our vehicle sensors in the field and improving our ability to catch and correct potential data quality issues at their source.
* **This role will be hybrid, with 2\-3 days in office,** based out of our New York, Philadelphia, or San Francisco offices.

**Experience / Skills**

* 5\-10 years of experience in perception for robotics
* Comfortable in a fast\-pace and high\-ownership environment. You’re excited to collaborate, but also comfortable developing your own opinions.
* Proficient in C\+\+ and Python
* Extensive experience developing SLAM solutions, ideally involving ground\-based LiDAR
* Experience with extrinsic and intrinsic sensor calibration, including automated data\-driven calibration
* Prior experience with ultra\-wide angle cameras is a nice\-to\-have

**What We Value**

* **Mission first.** We value team members who are focused on working towards the best outcomes for the customer and the business.
* **Curiosity.** We are constantly learning – from each other and from our customers.. We aren’t afraid to learn we were wrong in the process and adapt our approach accordingly.
* **Owners mindset.** If you see an opportunity for improvement, run with it. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere, no matter your role.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and equity package
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents
* Life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage
* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to support all new parents
* Flexible, unlimited paid time off
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Free OneMedical membership
* Commuter benefits
* Snacks, goodies, and team lunches provided twice a week to keep you fueled and connected with your colleagues.

**Salary**


The estimated salary range for this position is $160,000 \- $210,000 USD. Total compensation for this position is determined by skills, qualifications, relevant work experience, location, and other factors. This salary estimate excludes the value of any potential bonuses; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long\-term incentives. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City\-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.

### **Embedded Software Engineer – Job Description**

**Job Title:** Software Engineer  

**Department:** Engineering  

**Reports To:** Program Manager and Engineering Director  

**FLSA Status:** Exempt / Full\-time

**Security Clearance required**

**Salary Range:** $90,000 \- $125,000 Annually (depending on experience)

**ROLE**


We are seeking a skilled **Embedded Software Engineer** to design, develop, and integrate software for embedded systems. This role covers the full development lifecycle with a strong emphasis on testing and validation to ensure functionality and reliability. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to present and explain software solutions to internal teams and customers.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Perform full lifecycle development for embedded systems, including implementation, unit testing, and integration.
* Review customer requirements, translate them into specifications, and produce technical documentation, designs, and operational concepts.
* Collaborate closely with hardware engineers to ensure seamless integration of software with electronic components and boards.
* Develop and execute test plans and procedures; perform debugging, troubleshooting, and ensure compliance with functional specifications.
* Conduct design and code reviews, resolve defects, and adhere to established development processes, configuration management, and release practices.
* Work under technical leadership while demonstrating initiative and self\-direction.
* Design and implement software for real\-time operating systems (RTOS) with strict timing constraints.
* Develop low\-level device drivers and support component\-level integration.
* Support automated build and test pipelines for embedded software.
* Present and explain software designs and solutions to internal teams and customers.
**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Strong proficiency in C programming for embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
* Experience integrating software with custom processor\-based circuit card assemblies.
* Working knowledge of higher\-level programming languages, including C\+\+ and Python.
* Experience in requirements development and management.
* Familiarity with formal verification procedures.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment on projects with many requirements.
**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Bare\-metal, register\-level configuration/setup software
* Device driver development for UARTs, I²C, SPI, and similar interfaces.
* Experience with Yocto or Buildroot embedded Linux build environments.
* Experience with toolchains such as JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket (Git), and Jenkins.
* Knowledge of Requirements frameworks, especially DOORS, Jama and Excel.
* Experience with testing equipment, instrumentation, and data acquisition tools.
* Knowledge of messaging protocols within the OSI 7‑layer stack.
* Working knowledge of C\+\+, Python and C\#.
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience.
* US Person required; ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance.
* Position located in Melbourne, FL and Greenville, SC

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
TIAG is seeking an experienced **Systems Engineer** for a high\-priority, **three\-month surge effort** supporting a lab system at NIWC Atlantic in Charleston, SC.


The ideal candidate will possess deep hands\-on expertise in staging, configuring, and integrating enterprise\-class server environments and networking infrastructure. This role focuses on the physical and logical deployment of Dell Enterprise (Epic/PowerEdge) server platforms alongside Cisco networking hardware to establish a fully functional, secure lab environment.


Key Responsibilities:

* Hardware Staging \& Integration \- Unpack, rack, stack, power, cable, and configure Dell Epic/PowerEdge enterprise servers and Cisco network devices (switches, routers, firewalls).
* System Configuration \- Perform initial OS/hypervisor installations, firmware updates, and system\-level configurations on Dell servers.
* Network Integration \- Configure VLANs, subnets, routing protocols, and access controls on Cisco switches and routers in alignment with architecture designs.
* Lab Readiness \& Testing \- Conduct end\-to\-end connectivity, power\-on, and integration testing to ensure lab readiness for operational workloads and testing teams.
* Cybersecurity \& Compliance \- Apply STIGs (Security Technical Implementation Guides) and baseline hardening to both server platforms and network appliances. Documentation \- Create and maintain lab layout diagrams, cabled topology maps, rack elevations, configuration files, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Cross\-Functional Coordination \- Collaborate closely with NIWC project managers, lead architects, and network security teams to meet strict surge milestones.
* On\-site presence required at NIWC Atlantic facilities in Charleston, SC.
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs (racking heavy server and network hardware).
* Active DoD Secret clearance (Top Secret/SCI eligible preferred).
* Active DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (e.g., CompTIA Security\+ CE, CCNA Security, or equivalent).
* Minimum of 5–8 years of experience in systems engineering, network infrastructure, or lab deployment preferably within a DoD/Navy environment.
* Proven hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Enterprise server environments (Dell PowerEdge/Epic series, iDRAC, RAID configurations, and virtualized environments using VMware vSphere/ESXi).
* Proficiency in configuring Cisco enterprise switches, routers, and firewalls (Cisco IOS/NX\-OS, VLANs, Trunking, Spanning Tree, ACLs).


Preferred Qualifications:

* Familiarity with NIWC Atlantic processes, lab facilities, and security standards.
* Experience with EURAFCENT C4I systems or enterprise Navy architectures.
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or Dell Technologies Proven Professional certifications.
* Experience automating baseline deployments using scripting tools (Ansible, PowerShell, or Python).


TIAG is an equal opportunity employer and federal contractor or subcontractor. Consequently, the parties agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60\-1\.4(a), 41 CFR 60\-300\.5(a), and 41 CFR 60\-741\.5(a) and employment decisions shall be based solely on merit and without regard disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. TIAG takes proactive steps to employ and advance in employment qualified individuals without regard to disability or protected veteran status. The parties also agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements and may be subject and required to take action pursuant to the following laws and accompanying regulations:

  

The Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended (and its implementing regulations at 41 C.F.R. 60\-300\);  

Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, as amended (and its implementing regulations at 41 C.F.R 60\-741\); and
  

Executive Order 13496 (and its implementing regulations at 29 C.F.R. part 471, Appendix A to Subpart A).

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

2\. Maternity and Parental Leave Options

4\. 401(k) Plan

jobs.title: 929 - Automation Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**Controls Engineer**
=====================

Our client is seeking a hands\-on **Controls Engineer** to support, develop, and improve the automation and control systems within our automotive manufacturing operations. This position will be responsible for PLC programming, robotic systems, electrical controls, troubleshooting, equipment launches, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing equipment.


The ideal candidate has experience working in a fast\-paced automotive manufacturing environment and is comfortable troubleshooting equipment directly on the plant floor. Experience with injection molding, automated assembly, robotics, vision systems, and auxiliary equipment is highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Program, troubleshoot, modify, and maintain **PLC\-based control systems** for manufacturing equipment.
* Support **Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell Automation** PLCs, HMIs, drives, networks, and related control hardware.
* Troubleshoot electrical, controls, automation, and communication issues on production equipment.
* Program and troubleshoot industrial robotic systems used for material handling, assembly, inspection, and other automated processes.
* Support injection molding machines and associated automation, including robots, conveyors, fixtures, sensors, auxiliary equipment, and secondary assembly systems.
* Develop and modify PLC logic, HMI screens, control sequences, alarms, and machine interfaces.
* Troubleshoot servo systems, VFDs, sensors, safety circuits, industrial networks, and machine control panels.
* Support new equipment installation, commissioning, debugging, and production launch activities.
* Work with equipment suppliers and integrators during machine design, build, runoff, installation, and acceptance.
* Review electrical schematics, control panel designs, and equipment control standards.
* Support integration of new equipment into existing plant infrastructure and manufacturing processes.
* Assist Engineering and Maintenance with root\-cause analysis of equipment downtime and recurring controls\-related failures.
* Identify opportunities to improve equipment uptime, cycle time, reliability, quality, and operator safety.
* Maintain backups and documentation for PLC programs, HMI applications, robot programs, and other control systems.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance activities related to automation and controls.
* Provide technical support and training to maintenance technicians and production personnel.
* Ensure equipment modifications comply with company safety requirements and applicable electrical and machine\-safety standards.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred. Equivalent hands\-on controls experience will be considered.
* 3\+ years of controls, automation, or manufacturing engineering experience preferred.

jobs.title: Senior System Software Engineer - Datacenter Power Management
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is redefining accelerated computing and powering the next era of artificial intelligence. Our data\-center platforms bring together GPUs, CPUs, networking, systems, and software to solve some of the world’s most exciting computing problems. We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer to join NVIDIA’s Datacenter Performance and Power Management Software team. You will be responsible for architecting production software for datacenter power management controllers. Your work will also cover cluster\- level dynamic provisioning and power\-management control system technologies for next\-generation data\-centers.

  

You will work at the intersection of hardware architecture, embedded firmware, device drivers, operating systems, and AI workloads. Your responsibilities will span the entire product lifecycle—from initial architectural design and pre\-silicon validation through silicon bring\-up, productization, and deployment in extensive data\-center infrastructures. This is an outstanding chance to influence how next\-generation NVIDIA GPUs provide top\-tier performance, energy efficiency, and reliability.

 **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Architect, build, implement, and debug data center power and performance\-management software, with particular emphasis on end\-to\-end power management at racks and data halls.
* Develop real\-time controllers, policies, and mechanisms that dynamically optimize performance, power, thermals, and energy efficiency under demanding data\-center workloads.
* Drive features across the full product lifecycle: requirements, architecture, implementation, pre\-silicon validation, silicon bring\-up, productization, and production support.
* Collaborate with GPU architects and hardware designers to define hardware\-software interfaces and influence the power\-management capabilities of next\-generation processors.
* Analyze complex interactions among workloads, clocks, voltages, power limits, thermals, telemetry, and system\-level policies.
* Lead the investigation and resolution of complex power, performance, stability, and reliability issues spanning firmware, drivers, hardware, and platform software.
* Develop validation strategies and automation for functional correctness, transition latency, performance\-per\-watt, and robustness across operating conditions.
* Build clear architecture, interface, and compose specifications for new power\-management features.
* Partner with geographically distributed architecture, ASIC, firmware, driver, validation, platform, and data\-center systems teams.

* BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent experience.
* At least 12\+ years of extensive industry experience crafting system software, embedded firmware, device drivers, or other hardware\-related production software.
* Strong programming skills in C, including experience developing, debugging, and maintaining complex low\-level software.
* Deep understanding of operating\-system fundamentals, device\-driver architecture, embedded or real\-time software, concurrency, interrupt handling, and hardware programming.
* Experience interpreting hardware specifications and developing software interfaces for registers, telemetry, interrupts, and control mechanisms.
* Strong understanding of computer architecture and hardware\-software interactions.
* Proven ability to independently debug complex problems across multiple software and hardware layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across organizational and geographic boundaries.

 **Ways to Stand Out From the Crowd:**

* Background with architecting, designing, or implementing datacenter provisioning, monitoring, and managing power at a CSP/NCP.
* Hands\-on experience with GPU, CPU, accelerator, or SoC power and performance management.
* Background with crafting or implementing P\-state selection, DVFS, clock\-control, voltage\-control, power\-capping, thermal\-management, throttling, or workload\-aware control policies.
* Experience developing real\-time feedback controllers, including reasoning about stability, responsiveness, hysteresis, latency, and noisy telemetry.
* Understanding of electrical and platform considerations such as voltage\-frequency relationships, transient power, thermal limits, power delivery, and system\-level power budgets.

**Description**


Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.


Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

**About The Role:**


We are seeking a Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our high\-performance engineering organization as a full\-time, hands\-on individual contributor. In this role, you will be embedded within a cross\-functional team owning critical segments of our consumer ecosystem.


Our engineering organization is structured so that each domain team owns its vertical stack end\-to\-end—from backend microservices and APIs through frontend and DevOps. We are looking for an engineer with genuine depth across all layers of the stack who can move seamlessly between backend logic and rich frontend experiences, contributing independently within their first few weeks.


Beyond technical skills, we want someone who is innovative, proactive, and self\-driven—an engineer who actively seeks out better tools, raises quality standards, and delivers without waiting for direction. We place a premium on self\-learners who challenge the status quo, take genuine pride in the reliability of what they ship, and comfortably navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment.


Potential Teams you will get to work on:

* The Focus: Powering the leading builder listing platform in the US, empowering a diverse range of consumers to discover and customize their dream homes.
* What You’ll Work On: Building hyper\-customized web experiences for vibrant new communities, optimizing high\-velocity frontends for substantial traffic and search engine optimization (SEO), enhancing backend services, modernizing infrastructure, expanding automated test suites, and engineering automated developer toolchains for instantaneous cloud service provisioning.

* Modern Workflow Innovation: Leverage and champion the adoption of AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Windsurf, Portkey, Gemini) to optimize development workflows.
* Leadership \& Collaboration: Drive project delivery with strong personal ownership—managing scope, timelines, and cross\-functional dependencies. Communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders to build trust quickly.

* Backend Expertise: Utilize your strong experience with Node.js and microservice architectures.
* Domain Background: Leverage your experience building search, marketplace, listing\-based, or financial services products (e.g., loan application flows, rate calculators, lender/partner API integrations).

jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Lead Electrical Engineer serves as a technical leader responsible for the design, development, validation, commercialization, and sustaining support of advanced electronic systems for downhole drilling and measurement technologies. This position leads electrical engineering efforts across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and survivability in harsh high\-pressure/high\-temperature (HPHT) downhole environments.

The role provides technical leadership throughout the product lifecycle, from concept development and system architecture through qualification, commercialization, and field support. The successful candidate will collaborate with global engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and operational groups to develop innovative technologies that enhance company capabilities, improve reliability, and drive profitability.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITES:**

* Lead the design, development, validation, commercialization, and sustaining support of electrical and electronic systems for downhole drilling, measurement, and control technologies.
* Develop system architectures, design specifications, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
* Own PCB and electronic hardware development from concept through production release, including schematic capture, component selection, layout review, testing, troubleshooting, and manufacturability considerations.
* Design and qualify electronic systems capable of reliable operation in harsh downhole environments including high\-pressure, high\-temperature (HPHT), shock, and vibration conditions.
* Lead technical decision\-making and provide engineering guidance throughout all phases of product development while collaborating with mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.
* Develop and execute verification, qualification, environmental, and reliability test programs to ensure product performance, durability, and commercialization readiness.
* Lead root cause failure investigations, reliability improvement initiatives, corrective actions, and continuous improvement efforts to enhance product performance and field reliability.
* Manage multiple concurrent domestic and international engineering projects, ensuring technical, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved.
* Support field trials, product launches, customer demonstrations, and operational deployments while providing technical support to customers, sales, manufacturing, and field operations personnel.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement new technologies, products, and intellectual property opportunities that support strategic growth objectives and expand the company's technology portfolio.
* Collaborate with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and strategic partners to ensure component availability, product quality, manufacturability, and long\-term supportability.
* Serve as a technical liaison between global engineering teams, customers, and stakeholders while effectively communicating project status, technical risks, and development plans.
* Contribute to technology roadmaps, project planning, resource allocation, budget forecasting, and strategic business initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and development support to engineers and technicians while promoting a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with applicable company policies, engineering standards, quality systems, and regulatory requirements.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS****:**

· Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline

· Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in electrical engineering, R\&D, or product development

· Experience designing and validating electrical systems

· Hands\-on experience with board\-level design and ruggedization, bring\-up, and debugging

· Valid driver’s license

· Valid passport and the ability to travel both domestically (frequently) and internationally (occasionally)

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS (PREFERRED)****:**

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline
* Experience with
* embedded electronics and microcontroller\-based systems.
* high\-temperature electronic component selection and qualification.
* power management, battery systems, and low\-power electronics.
* EMC/EMI design and testing
* (PLM) systems and engineering change processes
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, CAN, RS\-485, Ethernet, and telemetry systems.
* Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), and design for testability (DFT).

For MWD/LWD specifically:

* Experience with downhole telemetry systems including mud pulse, electromagnetic, wired drill pipe, or rotary steerable technologies.
* Understanding of drilling dynamics, shock, vibration, and downhole environmental effects on electronics.

Join us to lead transformative projects that shape the future of electrical engineering! We value innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence—if you’re ready to make an impact in a fast\-paced environment dedicated to engineering advancement, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year

* Do you currently reside in the greater Houston area?

* Cypress, TX 77429 (Required)

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Associate- Level 1
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------



Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) is seeking a motivated entry\-level Electrical Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. MFC is a recognized designer, developer, and manufacturer of precision engagement aerospace and defense systems for the U.S. and allied militaries. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early\-career professional looking to develop hands\-on electrical engineering skills in a collaborative, mission\-driven environment.  

  

**What You Will Be Doing**  

  

The Associate Electrical Engineer will support the design, development, integration, and test of electrical hardware across a variety of defense programs. Responsibilities may include:  

  

* Assisting production and development teams with resolving technical challenges, incorporating engineering changes, updating drawings and assembly parts lists, and developing new designs or tools

  

* Supporting circuit card assembly (CCA) design, including schematic capture, PCB layout, and design documentation

  

* Performing circuit simulation and analysis using tools such as LTspice, PSpice, Simulink, NI Multisim, or MATLAB

  

* Utilizing test equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, signal generators, network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and logic analyzers) to support hardware bring\-up and troubleshooting

  

* Supporting hardware operations and providing assistance to engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams

  

* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to support design integration and interface resolution

  

* Developing and maintaining technical documentation, including test procedures, design reports, and engineering change documentation

  

This position offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced electrical engineering professionals and gain exposure to cutting\-edge defense technology. Strong career growth and advancement opportunities are available.  

  

Candidates may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.  

At Lockheed Martin we keep people safe and solve the world's most complex challenges. Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work. With our employees as our priority, we provide career opportunities designed to propel development and boost agility. Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. This is a place for engineers, scientists, and problem\-solvers who are ready to engage deeply, think critically, and build with purpose. You will not just launch a career. You will be part of something bigger. This is where the best are built. Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


- Bachelor Degree degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related STEM field from an accredited university.
  

  

- Experience with schematic capture and/ or PCB layout tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad, Mentor Graphics, Cadence, etc.)
  

  

- Experience with simulation tools (LTspice, PSpice, Simulink, NI Multisim, MATLAB, etc.)
  

  

- Familiarity with test equipment (This may include oscilloscope, multimeter, function generator, signal generator, network analyzer, spectrum analyzer, logic analyzer, etc.)
  

  

- Must be a US Citizen; must be able to obtain/maintain a DoD Secret clearance
**Desired Skills**
